notes: Ghost-cleanup reconciliation no longer silently erases a genuinely-filled position with zero audit trail: when a real Alpaca fill happened and the position is just gone from every configured account, the local delete now writes a trade_history row (exit_reason=RECONCILED_GHOST) with a best-effort exit price and correct P&L-based cash refund, instead of the no-history delete path meant only for user-initiated 'Delete trade'.
